propositions: The reconciler's committed .bridge_state cache consumes 92% of the 1.04 GiB tickets branch, with 1144 baseline_advanced_at writes per pass that are never read in src/

Scattered edits across the 18 MB bindings.json file defeat git delta compression, resulting in a measured marginal cost of 12.79 KB per version that can be reduced 7.4x by eliminating the timestamp field

The baseline_advanced_at timestamp field and last_get_pass rotation bookkeeping must be refactored to reduce churn: baseline_advanced_at should be deleted and last_get_pass moved to a separate get_rotation.json file
A quiesced git fast-export/fast-import history rewrite can reclaim the ~1 GiB of existing history while preserving all commits, merges, and producing a byte-identical HEAD tree
Mixed-version read/write compatibility must be maintained during the multi-phase rollout, with rollback gated by operator-attested epoch-mismatch refusal at both union_merge and push.py sites
Post-rewrite writer deployments must demonstrate fail-closed epoch-mismatch behavior and verify non-resurrection via ancestry checks and incremental pack growth <1 MB before accepting the rewrite
